This artificial Christmas tree adds a festive detail to your Christmas display. The white finish and plastic and metal construction give it a defined appearance for Christmas at home.

Style around the occasion

A flexible finishing touch

Plan the display

Care and presentation
Follow the care guidance for the stated material and handle decorative details gently. When the display changes, store the piece where its surface and shape will be supported, ready to bring out again for the next arrangement.

Product Features
Pre-Lit Design: This artificial Christmas tree features 170 warm white LED lights, creating a cosy and charming festive atmosphere in your space.
Reliable Material and Stable Structure: The faux leaves are made of odourless, flame-retardant PVC for reliable and long-lasting use. A stable crossed metal base with a pre-assembled screw provides strong and secure support.
Quick and Effortless Installation: The 180 cm Christmas tree features an innovative pop-up design for easy assembly. Simply install the supporting frame, place the pop-up tree section from top to bottom, and connect the top section.
Versatile Decoration: This full Christmas tree adds a festive touch to various settings, including living rooms, offices, storefronts, holiday gatherings, weddings and birthday parties.
Vivid and Natural Appearance: Featuring 517 lush branch tips with two types of leaves in different textures, this tree creates a full and natural look. Its thick flocked snow coating adds a touch of winter magic.
 
Specifications
Colour: Green
Material: PVC, Pine, Needles
Tree Height: 180cm
Stand Diameter: 45 cm
Tree Width: 76cm
Number of Branch Tips: 517
Number of LED Lights: 170
Number of Sections: 2
Net Weight: 7kg
 
Please Note
All dimensions are measured manually, so slight variations of 2–3 cm may occur.
Actual colours may vary slightly depending on monitor settings and screen displays.
Decorative items shown in the pictures are not included in the delivery.

Reliable Material and Stable Structure: The faux leaves of this tree are crafted of odorless and flame-retardant PVC material, ensuring reliability and longevity. Additionally, it is supported by a stable crossed metal base with a pre-assembled screw, providing strong and secure support.
Quick and Effortless Installation: The 180 cm artificial Christmas tree features an innovative pop up structure, which simplifies the installation process. All you need to do is install the supporting frame, place the pop-up tree section from the top down, and then connect the top section.
Versatile Decoration: This full Xmas tree is a versatile centerpiece that could add a festive touch to various settings, from cozy living rooms and stylish office spaces to elegant storefront displays, holiday gatherings, cheerful wedding and birthday party decorations.

Lightweight Design
The lightweight form is convenient to handle and move between suitable locations. It also makes the item easier to include when organising a bag or storage space.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion

Give the detail room to show

Imagine the possibilities it holds; perhaps Father Christmas himself dropped it during his magical Christmas Eve visit, leaving behind a piece of his extraordinary realm. Nestled within this captivating pouch are two Polar Pennies, crafted from solid metal and finished in a lustrous antique gold. Each coin, measuring a generous 4cm in diameter, bears the mark of the North Pole, a testament to the enchantment that resides there.

Christmas Wreath
This Christmas wreath adds a festive detail to your Christmas display. The red finish and plastic construction give it a defined appearance for Christmas at home.

Father Christmas Motif
A Father Christmas motif gives the design a recognisable festive character. It brings a seasonal focal point to the arrangement and can be paired with other Christmas decorations to create a consistent theme across the display.

Lightweight Design
The lightweight form is convenient to handle and move between suitable locations. It also makes the item easier to include when organising a bag or storage space.

Compact Format
The compact format helps the item fit into a smaller working or storage area. It is useful where you want the function close to hand without filling the whole space.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

5096042277239.variantName: Christmas wreath - Festive door decoration - Decorative bow and wired pine foliage, internal wire support for a festive entrance
5096042277239.sourceDescription:
A bow breaks up the soft outline of the pine-style foliage. The PVC branches have internal wire support, so the wreath can be arranged to show the bow clearly against a door, wall or tabletop setting.

A wreath puts the decoration on the door or wall itself, leaving the console or mantelpiece below free for cards and winter flowers. Its outline is complete in one piece, which is handy in an entrance where there is little space for a tree. Fine pine-style sprigs lend themselves to a simple woodland scheme. A plain background keeps the outline of the needles visible, especially where the foliage spreads towards the edge of the decoration.

The centre opening lets the background play a part in the design. Pale paint gives the foliage a sharp outline, while a darker panel draws attention to the texture at the tips of the branches.

A simple way to plan the setting is to mark the centre of the intended space with a small piece of paper. Hold the decoration over it, then step back to see how it sits alongside the door surround or other wall decorations. If you already have a busy Christmas tree, give the wreath a space of its own. A quiet patch of wall brings the outline into focus and gives visitors a chance to see the individual details as they pass.

On a mantel wall, the wreath can sit above the display while the shelf below stays clear for cards and small ornaments. Leave a little space between the top of the cards and the bottom of the wreath so their outlines remain distinct. When dressing an entrance, allow for the full movement of the door as well as the width of the decoration. Set it clear of the handle, letter plate and frame so the arrangement stays in position as people come and go.

A narrow ribbon in a colour taken from the design makes a discreet finishing touch if you use your own hanger.
Decorative bow and wired pine foliage for a festive entrance
Internal wire support allows the wreath to be arranged clearly against doors or walls
Complete one-piece outline is ideal for entrances with limited space
Pale painted foliage provides a sharp, visible needle outline

5096042275839.variantName: Christmas wreath - Christmas door wreath - Grapevine, berries and bows, pine cone accents for a festive entrance - Plastic, 40 cm
5096042275839.sourceDescription:
The grapevine design gives this wreath a twig-like outline. Bows, berries and pine cones sit against it in different shapes and sizes, so there is plenty to see when the wreath hangs at eye level. At 40 cm across, it is easy to measure out the space it will occupy before choosing a position.

A wreath puts the decoration on the door or wall itself, leaving the console or mantelpiece below free for cards and winter flowers. Its outline is complete in one piece, which is handy in an entrance where there is little space for a tree. From a few steps away the cones read as dark accents. Closer up, their overlapping scales contrast with the finer foliage. A simple ribbon or a nearby wooden decoration will pick up that woodland detail.

The centre opening lets the background play a part in the design. Pale paint gives the foliage a sharp outline, while a darker panel draws attention to the texture at the tips of the branches.

Hung on a panelled door, a wreath looks best when the edges of the panel still show. Centre it on the panel itself and look at it from the far end of the hall before choosing the final hanging height. On a mantel wall, the wreath can sit above the display while the shelf below stays clear for cards and small ornaments. Leave a little space between the top of the cards and the bottom of the wreath so their outlines remain distinct.

For an entrance used throughout the day, use a fixing suited to the door finish and the weight of the decoration. A trial positioning helps you check the view from both sides of an open door before committing to a spot. For a wall arrangement, try the wreath above a narrow console with the centre of the design just below eye level. A clear strip of wall between the wreath and the furniture shows off the outline and leaves the surface free for keys or Christmas cards.
Festive grapevine wreath adorned with bows, berries and pine cone accents for a traditional Christmas look.
Compact 40 cm diameter design fits perfectly on doors or walls without overwhelming the entrance space.
Durable plastic construction ensures long-lasting colour and shape retention throughout the holiday season.
Ready-to-hang complete arrangement adds instant festive charm to your home decor with minimal effort.
Comes with 1x Christmas wreath

Pine Cone Detail
Pine cone details add texture among the festive foliage. Their recognisable shapes help create a woodland inspired arrangement, making the decoration easy to coordinate with other natural looking Christmas accessories.

Red Berry Accents
Red berry accents introduce small points of colour among the surrounding foliage. They add contrast to the festive arrangement and make it straightforward to repeat a red colour theme across neighbouring Christmas accessories.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

Light with a purpose
Place the light where its effect will be most useful within the intended setting. The position influences how the surrounding surfaces look, so consider nearby furniture, reflective finishes and the direction from which the light will be viewed.

Build a considered arrangement
Lighting can help define a particular part of a room or display. Combine the product with the lighting already present and adjust its position to create the balance you want, allowing practical room lighting and decorative accents to work together.

Make the most of the design
Give the light enough surrounding space for its shape and illumination to be appreciated. A clear position helps prevent neighbouring objects from obscuring the effect and makes the product easier to reach for ordinary operation or care.

Match the setting
Use the stated power method and suitability when choosing a location. Consider access to the controls and any required connection, keeping the arrangement practical for the way the area is used throughout the day.

Coordinate your decor
The listed finish can be paired with existing accessories or used as a contrasting detail. Lighting is both a functional and decorative part of an arrangement, so its appearance when switched off can also contribute to the overall setting.

Arrange before use
Set up the light according to its supplied instructions and choose a compatible power supply where required. Position any lead so that the installation remains orderly, and keep access available for switching the product off or disconnecting it.

5029936969439.sourceDescription:
Bring the timeless magic of Raymond Briggs’ beloved The Snowman into your home this festive season with this enchanting LED Wax Candle from SnowTime. Beautifully crafted to capture the warmth and nostalgia of the classic story, this battery-powered candle combines the charm of traditional décor with the safety and convenience of modern LED lighting. Perfect for creating a cosy winter atmosphere, it’s a delightful addition to any Christmas display, mantle, or windowsill. The candle features a soft, realistic wax finish with a detailed illustration of The Snowman glowing warmly from within. Inside, a combination of warm white and ice white LEDs create a gentle flickering effect, mimicking the natural glow of a real candle without the risk of open flames or melting wax. The enchanting light shines through the wax surface and tiny star-shaped perforations, adding a magical sparkle that evokes the feeling of a snowy winter night. Powered by 3 × AA batteries (not included), this LED candle is designed for safe, energy-efficient operation and is suitable for indoor use only. It’s perfect for family homes, festive displays, or as part of a themed Christmas arrangement. With its officially licensed design and high-quality finish, this piece makes a wonderful gift for fans of The Snowman, collectors of festive décor, or anyone looking to add a gentle glow of nostalgia to their Christmas celebrations. Add a touch of winter wonder to your home this season — a decoration that brings joy, warmth, and the enduring spirit of The Snowman to your festive décor year after year.
Celebrate the magic of Raymond Briggs’ The Snowman with this officially licensed LED Wax Candle, designed by SnowTime to bring nostalgic warmth and festive cheer into your home.
Features a beautifully crafted wax exterior with a detailed illustration of The Snowman™, illuminated by warm white and ice white LEDs that create a realistic, gentle flickering effect.
Combines the charm of a traditional candle with modern LED safety — no flame, smoke, or mess — making it a perfect decoration for family homes and festive displays.
Battery powered for convenience, requiring 3 × AA batteries (not included), and suitable for indoor use, allowing easy placement on shelves, mantles, or windowsills.
A stunning Christmas decoration and a thoughtful gift for fans of The Snowman, collectors, and anyone wishing to add a glowing touch of winter magic to their holiday décor.
Guarantee - 3 months
